blocking_designs.primary: leave-one-block-out over 10 k-means blocks (the source study's scheme)
blocking_designs.secondary: 12 k-means blocks assigned round robin to 4 folds
blocking_designs.leave_one_landslide_out: folds grouped by the polygon each point came from, negatives in singleton groups; separates within-failure pseudo-replication from regional extrapolation, which spatial blocking confounds

duplicate_fraction_definition: fraction of points sharing their 11-factor vector with at least one other point of the same class (pandas keep=False)
negative_sampling: uniform over cells the elevation raster covers, rejecting any cell inside a landslide polygon, matched one-to-one to the positive count
